meta.title: 这里是世界第一城！！纽约！
meta.title_en: This Is the Number One City in the World: New York!
meta.topic: 旅行Vlog · 纽约 · 世界杯决赛

scenes.title_cn: 开场：纽约像被压缩过的地球
scenes.title_en: Opening: New York, a Compressed Earth
scenes.context: 博主以旁白开场：世界上只有两种城市——纽约和纽约以外的地方，曼哈顿不到60平方公里却浓缩了金钱、权力、艺术与罪恶。语域：纪录片式旁白，修辞密集。
sentences: 有人说这个世界上只有两种城市，纽约和纽约以外的地方。
Some people say there are only two kinds of cities in the world: New York, and everywhere that isn't New York.
only two kinds of cities（只有两种城市）；everywhere that isn't ...（除…以外的地方）
纽约像一座被压缩过的地球，金钱、权力、艺术、罪恶、梦想，所有能在人间燃烧的东西，都在这个面积不足60平方公里的曼哈顿岛上日夜燃烧。
New York is like a compressed Earth — money, power, art, vice, and dreams, everything that can burn in this world, burns day and night on this island of Manhattan, barely sixty square kilometers.
a compressed Earth（被压缩过的地球）；burn day and night（日夜燃烧）；barely sixty square kilometers（面积不足60平方公里）
在这里你会觉得自己无比渺小，也会觉得自己无所不能。
Here you feel incredibly small, and at the same time capable of anything.
incredibly small（无比渺小）；capable of anything（无所不能
paraphrase: 纽约以外的地方 → everywhere that isn't New York / anywhere but New York
everywhere that isn't · anywhere but
无所不能 → capable of anything / you can do anything / nothing is out of reach
capable of anything · out of reach
scenes.speak: Some people say there are only two kinds of cities in the world: New York, and everywhere that isn't New York. New York is like a compressed Earth — money, power, art, vice, and dreams, everything that can burn in this world, burns day and night on this island of Manhattan, barely sixty square kilometers. Here you feel incredibly small, and at the same time capable of anything.

scenes.title_cn: 世界杯决赛：为什么大家愿意坐在一起
scenes.title_en: The World Cup Final: Why We Sit Together
scenes.context: 博主介绍这次带着8万元世界杯决赛门票飞越太平洋，感慨没有哪座城市比纽约更懂不同国家、不同语言、不同信仰的人为何愿意坐在一起看同一件事。语域：旁白+叙述。
sentences: 我们带着一张价值8万元的世界杯门票，飞越了整个太平洋。
We flew across the entire Pacific with a World Cup final ticket worth eighty thousand yuan.
fly across the Pacific（飞越太平洋）；worth eighty thousand yuan（价值8万元）
没有哪一座城市比纽约更懂得，来自不同国家、说着不同语言、相信着不同故事的人，为什么仍然愿意坐在一起，看着同一件事情发生。

No city understands better than New York why people from different countries, speaking different languages, believing in different stories, are still willing to sit together and watch the same thing happen.
No city understands better than ...（没有哪座城市比…更懂）；believe in different stories（相信着不同故事）
欢迎来到美国往事，纽约，第一集。
Welcome to Once Upon a Time in America, New York, Episode One.
Once Upon a Time in America（美国往事，电影名）；Episode One（第一集
paraphrase: 没有哪座城市更懂 → no city understands better than ... / no city gets this better than ...
no city understands better · gets this better
坐在一起看同一件事 → sit together and watch the same thing happen / come together to witness one moment
sit together · witness one moment
scenes.speak: We flew across the entire Pacific with a World Cup final ticket worth eighty thousand yuan. No city understands better than New York why people from different countries, speaking different languages, believing in different stories, are still willing to sit together and watch the same thing happen. Welcome to Once Upon a Time in America, New York, Episode One.

scenes.title_cn: 把纽约想象成北京：Uptown 与 Downtown
scenes.title_en: Think of New York as Beijing: Uptown & Downtown
scenes.context: 博主把纽约的地理解释为：Uptown相当于北京北城（上风上水），Downtown相当于南城（唐人街、小意大利、华尔街都在那里），中央公园是富人区分界线。语域：科普讲解，类比说明。
sentences: 咱们就把纽约想象成北京，因为纽约跟北京是有相像的地方。
Just think of New York as Beijing, because the two cities have a lot in common.
think of A as B（把A想象成B）；have a lot in common（有很多相似之处）
Uptown基本上就是上风上水的地方，相当于北京的北城。
Uptown is basically the prime, upscale area — the equivalent of northern Beijing.
prime, upscale area（上风上水的地方）；the equivalent of（相当于）
以中央公园为分界线，很多富人区都集中在北城。
With Central Park as the dividing line, most of the wealthy neighborhoods are in the north.
dividing line（分界线）；wealthy neighborhoods（富人区
paraphrase: 把A想象成B → think of A as B / imagine A as B / picture A as B
think of as · picture as
以…为分界线 → with X as the dividing line / divided by X
dividing line · divided by
scenes.speak: Just think of New York as Beijing, because the two cities have a lot in common. Uptown is basically the prime, upscale area — the equivalent of northern Beijing. With Central Park as the dividing line, most of the wealthy neighborhoods are in the north.

scenes.context: 博主排队一个多小时去吃1888年开业的全美最早的熏牛肉三明治店，介绍店里现切现腌、腌制30天以上的工艺。语域：美食探店，生活化口播。
sentences: 这家店是1888年一直开业到现在，100多年了。
This place has been open since eighteen eighty-eight — over a hundred years.
been open since（从…营业至今）；over a hundred years（100多年）
所有的肉都是现给你切，它只用里边最嫩的肉，全部都是手工腌制。
Every slice is cut to order — they only use the most tender meat inside, all hand-cured.
cut to order（现切）；tender meat（嫩肉）；hand-cured（手工腌制）
每一块肉都是要腌制30天以上。
Every piece of meat is cured for at least thirty days.
be cured for（腌制…时间）；at least thirty days（至少30天
paraphrase: 现切 → cut to order / sliced fresh for you / cut right in front of you
cut to order · sliced fresh
手工腌制 → hand-cured / cured by hand / dry-cured
hand-cured · dry-cured
scenes.speak: This place has been open since eighteen eighty-eight — over a hundred years. Every slice is cut to order — they only use the most tender meat inside, all hand-cured. Every piece of meat is cured for at least thirty days.

scenes.title_cn: 纽约物价：寸土寸金的代价
scenes.title_en: The Cost of New York: Paying for Prime Land
scenes.context: 博主讲解纽约物价：平均房租是全美三倍多，单身人士年收入需约5万美元才能活得舒服；曼哈顿一套能俯瞰中央公园的公寓卖到6000多万美元。语域：数据讲解，感叹语气。
sentences: 在曼哈顿寸土寸金的地方，能俯瞰整个中央公园的公寓，卖到了6000万美元。
In Manhattan, where every inch of land is precious, an apartment overlooking all of Central Park sells for sixty million dollars.
every inch of land is precious（寸土寸金）；overlook（俯瞰）
一个单身人士在纽约，年薪5万美元才能活得舒服。
A single person in New York needs an annual income of fifty thousand dollars just to live comfortably.
annual income（年薪）；live comfortably（活得舒服）
纽约从你落地的第一分钟起，就在彬彬有礼地提醒你：欢迎来到世界之巅，但是也请支付世界之巅的价格。
From the first minute you land, New York politely reminds you: welcome to the top of the world — but please pay the price of the top of the world.
politely remind（彬彬有礼地提醒）；the top of the world（世界之巅
paraphrase: 寸土寸金 → every inch of land is precious / land is at a premium
every inch is precious · at a premium
世界之巅 → the top of the world / at the very top
top of the world · the very top
scenes.speak: In Manhattan, where every inch of land is precious, an apartment overlooking all of Central Park sells for sixty million dollars. A single person in New York needs an annual income of fifty thousand dollars just to live comfortably. From the first minute you land, New York politely reminds you: welcome to the top of the world — but please pay the price of the top of the world.

scenes.title_cn: 老友记体验馆：橘色沙发
scenes.title_en: The Friends Experience: The Orange Sofa
scenes.context: 下雨的行程中，博主临时去老友记体验馆，打开门看到那张熟悉的橘色沙发，感动到起鸡皮疙瘩。语域：旅行vlog，情绪化叙述。
sentences: 因为下雨这个行程很临时，我没有做太多的攻略。
Because it was raining, this stop was very last-minute, and I hadn't done much research.
last-minute（临时决定的）；do research（做攻略）
直到那扇门打开以后，我看到了那张熟悉的橘色沙发。
When the door finally opened, I saw that familiar orange sofa.
familiar（熟悉的）；orange sofa（橘色沙发）
一进来看到咖啡厅的时候，我真的有点想落泪的感觉。
The moment I walked in and saw the coffee shop, I really felt like I might cry.
the moment I ...（一…就…）；feel like crying（想落泪
paraphrase: 临时决定 → last-minute / spur-of-the-moment / on a whim
last-minute · spur-of-the-moment
想落泪 → feel like crying / tears welled up / got choked up
feel like crying · choked up
scenes.speak: Because it was raining, this stop was very last-minute, and I hadn't done much research. When the door finally opened, I saw that familiar orange sofa. The moment I walked in and saw the coffee shop, I really felt like I might cry.

scenes.title_cn: 中央公园：最贵土地上的公共空间
scenes.title_en: Central Park: Public Space on the Priciest Land
scenes.context: 博主来到中央公园，讲解为什么曼哈顿房价高：公园占了最贵的地却不属于任何人；还提到绵羊草坪和公园从150万建到1000多万美元的历史。语域：科普+生活记录。
sentences: 它占据了曼哈顿最昂贵的土地，却不属于任何一个人。
It occupies the most expensive land in Manhattan, yet belongs to no one.
occupy the most expensive land（占据最昂贵的土地）；belong to no one（不属于任何人）
中央公园如果全部拿来盖楼，曼哈顿的房价可能就会跌下来了。
If Central Park were all built over, Manhattan property prices would probably drop.
built over（被开发盖楼）；property prices（房价）
那边是绵羊草坪，可能当年修公园之前，有很多绵羊在吃草。
That's Sheep Meadow — before the park was built, there were probably lots of sheep grazing here.
Sheep Meadow（绵羊草坪）；grazing（吃草
paraphrase: 占据最贵土地 → occupy the most expensive land / sit on the priciest real estate
occupy · sit on
盖楼 → build over / develop / cover with buildings
build over · develop
scenes.speak: It occupies the most expensive land in Manhattan, yet belongs to no one. If Central Park were all built over, Manhattan property prices would probably drop. That's Sheep Meadow — before the park was built, there were probably lots of sheep grazing here.

scenes.title_cn: 重新出发：纽约不会承诺你成功
scenes.title_en: Begin Again: New York Promises Nothing
scenes.context: 博主回顾《再次出发》这部电影：他们没有昂贵的录音棚，却把城市的杂音变成了音乐；后来明白纽约真正迷人的地方是它给你一个足够大的舞台。语域：影评式旁白，抒情。
sentences: 他们没有昂贵的录音棚，没有能够保证成功的未来，但他们把城市的杂音、风声、地铁声、脚步声，全部都变成了音乐的一部分。
They had no expensive recording studio and no guaranteed future, but they turned the city's noise — wind, subway, footsteps — all into part of the music.
recording studio（录音棚）；turn noise into music（把杂音变成音乐）
纽约真正迷人的地方也许就在这里：它不会承诺你成功，它只会给你一个足够大的舞台。
Maybe this is what's truly fascinating about New York: it doesn't promise you success; it just gives you a big enough stage.
truly fascinating（真正迷人的）；a big enough stage（足够大的舞台）
让你带着自己的不甘心、热爱和一点点天真，继续往前走。
So you can keep going with your ambition, your passion, and a little bit of innocence.
ambition（不甘心/野心）；innocence（天真
paraphrase: 把杂音变成音乐 → turn noise into music / make music out of the city's sounds
turn into · make out of
不甘心 → ambition / a refusal to settle / not accepting defeat
ambition · refusal to settle
scenes.speak: They had no expensive recording studio and no guaranteed future, but they turned the city's noise — wind, subway, footsteps — all into part of the music. Maybe this is what's truly fascinating about New York: it doesn't promise you success; it just gives you a big enough stage. So you can keep going with your ambition, your passion, and a little bit of innocence.

scenes.title_cn: 足球的本质：把冲突交给规则
scenes.title_en: The Essence of Football: Rules Over Rivalry
scenes.context: 阿根廷与西班牙的世界杯决赛，博主作为非球迷感慨：足球把野心与愤怒锁进90分钟和17条规则里；当战争让对话失去出口，足球却留下了一块草坪。语域：哲思旁白。
sentences: 所有的野心、暴力、愤怒、荣誉、不甘，都可以被锁进90分钟和17条规则里。
All the ambition, violence, anger, honor, and frustration can be locked into ninety minutes and seventeen rules.
be locked into（被锁进）；seventeen rules（17条规则）
当战争让许多对话都失去了出口，足球却依然被它留下了一块草坪。
When war silences so many conversations, football still leaves a patch of grass open.
lose an outlet（失去出口）；a patch of grass（一块草坪）
只要那颗球还在草地上滚动，人类就还愿意把冲突交给规则，而不是交给彼此。
As long as the ball keeps rolling on the grass, humanity is still willing to hand its conflicts to the rules, not to each other.
as long as（只要）；hand conflicts to the rules（把冲突交给规则
paraphrase: 失去出口 → lose an outlet / leave no room for dialogue
lose an outlet · no room for dialogue
把冲突交给规则 → hand conflicts to the rules / settle disputes by the rules
hand conflicts to · settle disputes by
scenes.speak: All the ambition, violence, anger, honor, and frustration can be locked into ninety minutes and seventeen rules. When war silences so many conversations, football still leaves a patch of grass open. As long as the ball keeps rolling on the grass, humanity is still willing to hand its conflicts to the rules, not to each other.

scenes.title_cn: 结尾：纽约会永远留在镜头里
scenes.title_en: Closing: New York Stays in My Lens
scenes.context: 决赛夜后的时代广场，博主总结：技术让镜头更像人，但替代不了我们为什么记录；纽约不会记住我，但它会永远留在我的镜头里。语域：收尾抒情旁白。
sentences: 这座城市没有因为一场世界杯决赛而改变什么，它见过了太多的伟大与渺小。
This city didn't change because of a World Cup final — it has seen too much greatness and too much smallness.
greatness and smallness（伟大与渺小）；see too much of（见过太多）
技术正在让镜头更像人，但它替代不了的，始终是我们为什么记录。
Technology is making the camera more human, but what it can never replace is why we record at all.
make the camera more human（让镜头更像人）；why we record（我们为什么记录）
纽约不会记住我，但它会永远留在我的镜头里。
New York won't remember me, but it will stay in my lens forever.
won't remember me（不会记住我）；stay in my lens（留在镜头里
paraphrase: 伟大与渺小 → greatness and smallness / the grand and the trivial
greatness and smallness · the grand and the trivial
为什么记录 → why we record / the reason we capture moments
why we record · capture moments
scenes.speak: This city didn't change because of a World Cup final — it has seen too much greatness and too much smallness. Technology is making the camera more human, but what it can never replace is why we record at all. New York won't remember me, but it will stay in my lens forever.

practice: 形容纽约的浓缩与繁华
New York is like a compressed Earth where everything burns day and night.
解释 Uptown 和 Downtown 的区别
Uptown is the upscale area, while Downtown is where the history began.
感慨这趟旅程的临时决定
It was a last-minute stop because of the rain, and I hadn't done much research.
Football locks all our ambition and anger into ninety minutes and seventeen rules.
pitfalls: The apartment sells for sixty million dollars.
「卖多少钱」用 sell for / go for；直接说 is 60 million dollars 是中式表达，缺动词短语。
don't 是一般现在时的否定，这里是「不会」记住我（未来），用 won't；且 New York 是第三人称单数。
Every slice is cut to order.
「现切」的地道表达是 cut to order（按单现做），不是 cut now。
feel like 后接动名词 crying，不接不定式 to cry。
shifts: 用 sell for（卖价）、be priced at（标价）、property prices（房价）、at a premium（高溢价）
说想哭只会 want to cry
用 feel like crying、tears welled up、got choked up 等层次更细的表达
按语境用 the World Cup final（决赛）、a penalty shootout（点球大战）、extra time（加时）
